prompts.front:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production layered 2D cutout-animation PARTS ATLAS for the same anime/chibi fantasy adventurer in the reference.
Preserve reference identity: chestnut tousled hair, simple large dark eyes, teal tunic, cream rolled sleeves, ochre scarf, brown belt, dark trousers, brown ankle boots; restrained hand-painted shading and clean outline. These are disassembled drawing layers used on a real skeleton. Do NOT draw complete assembled people or walking poses.
Canvas is a precise 4 columns by 4 rows regular square grid, exactly SIXTEEN isolated body pieces, one part centered in each equal cell. Keep at least 15% transparent margin around EVERY part, including hair. Each piece is complete including overlap at joints, not cropped. Pieces can be sized to fit their cell; the engine will measure and scale them.
Rows and columns read left to right:
Row1: (1) HAIR ONLY, full chestnut hairstyle as a wearable cap/wig, transparent face opening, no skin/eyes; (2) HEAD ONLY, bald skin head including face and ears/neck, NO hair; (3) TORSO ONLY, teal shirt body with cream collar and ochre scarf, no head/arms/pelvis; (4) PELVIS ONLY, dark trouser waist with brown belt, no torso or legs.
Row2: (1) left upper arm only with cream rolled sleeve, shoulder-to-elbow; (2) left forearm only, skin elbow-to-wrist, no hand; (3) left hand only relaxed closed fist with short wrist; (4) right upper arm only, cream rolled sleeve, shoulder-to-elbow.
Row3: (1) right forearm only skin elbow-to-wrist; (2) right hand only relaxed fist and short wrist; (3) left THIGH only dark trousers hip-to-knee; (4) left SHIN only dark trousers knee-to-ankle, NO shoe.
Row4: (1) left BOOT only brown ankle boot; (2) right THIGH only dark trousers hip-to-knee; (3) right SHIN only dark trousers knee-to-ankle, NO shoe; (4) right BOOT only brown ankle boot.
Anatomical left and right refer to character sides. Limb segments should be neutral and mostly vertical, top joint at top and distal joint at bottom, with overlapping rounded ends, not extreme poses. No exposed red cut surfaces; these are clean art layers like clothing and cartoon puppet pieces.
Critical: only the named isolated part in each cell, not connected to neighboring body parts. Keep the viewpoint consistent across all parts. No text, labels, grid lines, ground, shadows, checkerboard pattern, scenery or props. Genuinely transparent background alpha.
DIRECTION FOR THIS ENTIRE ATLAS: southeast / toward viewer and screen RIGHT, FRONT-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER, matching the TOP ROW of reference. Both eyes visible with farther eye smaller. See shirt front and belt buckle, toes toward screen lower-right, visible head top from a camera about 31 degrees above ground. All parts belong to this single facing, never straight front or pure profile.
